item.title: Statistical analysis of experimental data
item.description:
Field Detail
What it solves Documents, step by step, an analysis of variance (ANOVA) and a Tukey test in R on data from an agronomic experiment.
Status Published.
License MIT, “Copyright (c) 2024 Daniel Arbeláez Álvarez”.
Code HammerDev99/analisis_estadistico_datos_expetimentales
Started First commit: 31 October 2024.
Recognition None.
Measured result No public figures; code open.
Authorship Personal project of the author, developed with the author’s own equipment and accounts, without any commission or instruction from any entity or office.

What it does

  • Compares treatments with ANOVA and the Tukey test.
  • Plots the differences between groups and saves the results to CSV.

Technologies

R, RStudio, ggplot2, dplyr, readr and multcompView.

Personal free-software tool, published in a personal capacity. It does not represent the Judicial Branch; using it in a court office requires the corresponding institutional authorizations.
